name: tuckit
description: Use tuckit as your project's single source of truth: domain knowledge, board-freshness hooks, and a design->execute->verify->ship workflow that writes every artifact to the board instead of to docs/. A replacement for Superpowers' planning skills, not a companion to them.

mcp_url.title: tuckit MCP URL
mcp_url.description: tuckit's MCP endpoint. Leave the default for tuckit Cloud; set your own only if you self-host. Do not put a workspace in it: each repository names its board in a .tuckit file, so one login serves every project on this machine. Authorization happens in your browser on first use — no token to paste.

tuckit.headersHelper: python3 -c "import json,os,pathlib,re,sys;d=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 and sys.argv[1] else '.').resolve();f=next((p/'.tuckit' for p in [d,*d.parents] if os.path.lexists(p/'.tuckit')),None);t=f.read_text(errors='replace') if f is not None and f.is_file() and os.access(f,os.R_OK) else '';m=re.search(r'^\s*workspace\s*=\s*\x22([a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,99})\x22[ \t]*(?:\r?\n|\Z)',t,re.M);print(json.dumps({} if f is None else {'X-Tuckit-Workspace':m.group(1) if m else '!unreadable '+str(f).encode('ascii','backslashreplace').decode()}))" '${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}'
